mapper.select: SELECT participant_key, MAX(masked_display_name) AS masked_display_name, goal, source, COALESCE(SUM(completed_sessions), 0) AS completed_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN completed_sessions > 0 THEN sample_date END) AS active_days, COALESCE(SUM(planned_sessions), 0) AS planned_count, COALESCE(SUM(cancelled_sessions), 0) AS cancelled_count, COALESCE(SUM(actual_calories), 0) AS actual_calories FROM comparison_daily_samples WHERE sample_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND (source <> 'SYNTHETIC' OR #{includeSynthetic} = TRUE) GROUP BY participant_key, goal, source HAVING SUM(completed_sessions + planned_sessions + cancelled_sessions) > 0 ORDER BY participant_key
